title: fix: let Windows updates validate staged plugin dependencies
body:
Fixes #200573

## What Problem This Solves

Windows npm-global updates can roll back during candidate Doctor even when the rejected `typebox` dependency is present inside the staged package. The reporter encountered this four times across three target releases, leaving managed updates unusable on that installation.

## User Impact

Candidate Doctor accepts private plugin dependencies inside the staged OpenClaw package, including nested `node_modules`, without requiring an updated updater. Existing pnpm-store and npm-hoisted resolution from trusted candidate code stays unchanged. Plugin entries and repair writes remain private-only.

## Why This Change Was Made

The [main assertion at update-candidate-plugin-repair.ts:44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/176f2ff9652ea6539192a7c580940ced94b27942/src/infra/update-candidate-plugin-repair.ts#L44) checked resolved private-plugin dependencies only against the separate rehearsal directory. The snapshot owner intentionally links private plugins to the staged package, using Windows junctions, so a dependency inside that package could be rejected.

The fix preserves main's source predicate and private lookup rule exactly. For those private-sourced reads, [the accepted target roots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c4dcd98dd457c6b639cce8d6dec528eeeddbacc3/src/infra/update-candidate-plugin-repair.ts#L81) are the private rehearsal root and the canonical candidate package root, checked after resolving links. Trusted candidate-sourced references retain their existing dependency resolution. Explicit external imports keep main's existing semantics. The stale `memory-wiki` install-record warning is separate and absent from the reproduction.

## Evidence

The same final matrix fixtures ran against the actual main-base repair module (`176f2ff9652`), then the fix. For valid rows, a private plugin imports `typebox` inside the candidate package, and `typebox` imports `vendor` from the named layout. The pnpm store and npm hoist are outside the candidate package directory. External controls move the private plugin's dependency into a separate serving or user tree. Accepted cases also execute the plugin successfully with Node.

| Candidate dependency layout / private plugin import | Main base | Fix without handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pnpm store / private junction | Rejected | Accepted |
| npm hoisted / private junction | Rejected | Accepted |
| Windows-style nested junction / private junction | Rejected | Accepted |
| pnpm store / explicit candidate file URL | Accepted | Accepted |
| npm hoisted / explicit candidate file URL | Accepted | Accepted |
| Windows-style nested junction / explicit candidate file URL | Accepted | Accepted |
| Serving installation / private junction | Rejected | Rejected |
| User directory / private junction | Rejected | Rejected |

**No main-pass/fix-fail cell.** Main produced 3 expected acceptance failures and 5 passing tests; the fix passes all 8 matrix cases. The explicit candidate-URL rows protect main's existing successful behavior. The external controls originate in the private plugin copy. A separate case rejects a candidate-package junction that resolves into the serving installation.

- Three named suites passed: **70 tests passed, 2 existing filesystem-specific skips**, **63.80 s** wall time including cold worker compilation: `update-candidate-plugin-sources.test.ts`, `update-candidate-plugin-tree.test.ts`, and `update-candidate-snapshot.plugin-inspection.test.ts`. The main-base matrix run took **38.45 s**, including compilation. CI test seconds are pending.
- Exact core-leaf lint passed for every TypeScript file touched by this revision: `timeout 120s pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware --type-check --threads=1 --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json <files>`. Touched-file `oxfmt --check` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent Codex autoreview of the final local delta against `62c7c4c5` completed **scoped-clean at P0–P2**, with no actionable findings.
- pr-simplify completed. The final PR changes only three files: production **+12/-11**, tests **+90/-2**, docs **+10** against main. The handoff, updater callback/environment changes, candidate-source assertions, and unrelated catch reorder have been removed; those updater files match main.

## Limits

**No native Windows run was done.** These are Linux boundary tests with real temporary directories and junction-compatible symlinks. No native bun run, actual package-manager installation, full managed update, or stable-to-candidate upgrade was performed. The reporter's exact importer remains uncaptured.

No install-root handoff is retained: current validation runs recovery with `--check`, so delivery of that environment to compatibility candidate Doctor was not proved. The fix uses the candidate-package root for both old and new updaters, with no new marker or protocol. Direct private-plugin dependency targets remain bounded by the private and candidate-package roots; trusted candidate code retains main's package-manager resolution.

Reported by @desksk (with four reproductions and a layout analysis)
